items.title: 3,280,081 Fortinet Devices Online With Exposed Web Properties Under Risk
items.description: Over 3,280,081 Fortinet Devices Were exposed, with web properties running vulnerable Fortinet devices affected by CVE-2026-24858, a severe authentication-bypass flaw actively exploited in the wild. items.title: Wireshark 4.6.3 Released With Vulnerabilities Dissector and Parser Crash
items.description: The Wireshark Foundation has officially released Wireshark 4.6.3, the latest update to the world’s most popular network protocol analyzer. This release is critical for network administrators, security analysts, and developers, as it addresses multiple security vulnerabilities that could lead to denial-of-service (DoS) conditions through dissector and parser crashes.
